name: Antipaladin — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Antipaladin from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Antipaladin", "Antipaladin" but are not part of the Antipaladin entry, which is unchanged. Sources named on the page for these sections: The Antipaladin’s Almanac, © 2020, Librarians & Leviathans..

From d20pfsrd.com: Antipaladin

3rd Party Options

Source The Antipaladin’s Almanac, © 2020, Librarians & Leviathans.

Although all antipaladins commune with vile forces and blasphemous spirits, some are able to do so in ways that transcend the typical martial gifts or diabolical servitors.

When an antipaladin gains the fiendish boon class feature, she can choose one of the following variant fiendish boons instead of those outlined by her class.

All variant fiendish boons are supernatural abilities, and an antipaladin cannot choose a variant fiendish boon if she has an archetype that alters or replaces fiendish boon.

Asura Bond

As a swift or immediate action, the antipaladin can call upon her asura spirit to gain fast healing 2, which is negated by good-aligned weapons and spells. She can gain this benefit for 3 rounds per day + 1 round per antipaladin level. This duration need not be consecutive.

Daemon Bond

As a standard action, the antipaladin can call forth a daemon spirit that bonds to her hands for 1 minute per antipaladin level, causing her to manifest traits evocative of one kind of daemon.

This bond allows the antipaladin to add her Charisma bonus to the amount of hit point damage that she deals with her negative energy spells, her corrupting touch ability, and her channel energy ability. For every 3 levels beyond 5th, she deals 1 additional hit point with those abilities, up to a maximum of 5 + her Charisma modifier at 20th level.

Demodand Bond

As a standard action, the antipaladin can call forth a demodand spirit that bonds to her, spreading a foul miasma of blasphemous power. This bond allows the antipaladin to shed gloom as per twilight haze for 1 minute per antipaladin level. Additionally, while the miasma spreads, all allies within 20 feet gain a profane +3 bonus on saving throws against divine magic and resistance 3 against sacred damage, such as that dealt by smite evil or by flame strike.

While all paladins are true believers, not all are the knights in shining armor with glimmering blades portrayed in legends— some are the dread antipaladins cloaked in veils of darkness, who can even walk the cursed path of undeath.

Presented below are several variant class features to help flesh out common antipaladin archetypes, the better to customize characters for fighting the foul fight.

Table: Archetypes / Alternate Class Features
Archetype / Alternate Class Feature	Class Features Changed or Replaced
Class Skills	Weapon & Armor	Aura of Evil	Code of Conduct	Detect Good	Smite Good	Unholy Resilience	Touch of Corruption	Aura of Cowardice	Plague Bringer	Cruelty	Channel Negative Energy	Spells	Fiendish Boon	Aura of Despair	Aura of Vengeance	Aura of Sin	Aura of Depravity	Unholy Champion

From d20pfsrd.com: Antipaladin

Smite Good (Su)

At 1st level the Antipaladin learns how to crush good in the world. As a free action they can designate a target they can see for their Smite Good. If the target is good they gain a bonus equal to their Charisma + half level to attack and damage rolls (both are minimum of 1, thus the total minimum is a +2 bonus). In addition to this, the Antipaladin bypasses any DR the foe may have (even DR/-) and they receive a Profane bonus to AC equal to Charisma modifier.

If the target of the Smite is an Outsider (Good), an good-aligned Dragon, good-aligned Fey, a good divine spellcaster, or Paladin, the bonus to attack and damage is instead the Antipaladin’s Charisma + Level.

Unholy Style

At 1st level the Antipaladin is trained in a technique which cements the way they go about fighting good in the world. They receive two Styles, one is determined by their alignment and the other is one they choose themselves.

Alignment:

Lawful Evil: So long as the Antipaladin has at least 1 Stamina Point, they receive a +1 bonus to disarm, dirty trick, and feint attempts. This increases by +1 for each 5 levels they possess (maximum of +5 at 20th).
Neutral Evil: So long as the Antipaladin has at least 1 Stamina Point, they receive 1d6 sneak attack dice as per the Rogue. This increases by +1d6 for each 5 levels they possess (maximum of 5d6 at 20th).
Chaotic Evil: So long as the Antipaladin has at least 1 Stamina Point, they can be healed by both positive energy and negative energy used for healing, however they are also harmed by positive energy and negative energy used to harm.

Choice:

Champion: The Antipaladin gains Weapon Focus in a single weapon group of their choice.
Defender: Adjacent allies to the Antipaladin receive a profane bonus to AC equal to the Antipaladin’s Cha modifier.
Conniver: The Antipaladin receives 1 rank in Diplomacy if they did not already have it, and a +5 bonus to Diplomacy checks made to improve someone’s attitude.
Clergy: The Antipaladin receives a bonus spell level per day for each spell level.
Duelist: The Antipaladin receives Two-Weapon Fighting as a bonus feat.
Hunstman: The Antipaladin receives Point Blank Shot as a bonus feat.
Shadow: The Antipaladin in dim light increase the miss chance by +20%.
Glory: Once per day the Antipaladin can allow a single ally within line of sight to gain the benefit of their Smite and Smite Powers.
